scientific.integrity: The motivating full text was inspected at the pointwise age-structured system, characteristic reduction, temporal Volterra equation, transform, stationary-speed equations, speed definition, numerical initial conditions, positive-speed tables, and discussion. The 2024 diffusion comparator was inspected at its full-text model equations. General integral-equation and rabies references were compared at accessible abstracts; their full texts were not confirmed. The universal proof uses pointwise uniqueness and elementary Laplace monotonicity, with an exact rational certificate of an admissible supercritical example. Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific.limitations: The result concerns the source's spatially uncoupled age-structured equations with positive local exit mass and its exact speed definition; it excludes creation of new infection support from compact initial infection and gives zero variational speed, not frozen contour levels for noncompact initial infection. No claims are made for diffusion-augmented systems or the actual numerical implementation.

title: Zero invasion speed and no speed-selection root in a spatially uncoupled COVID-19 model
